title: Arranging Coins
description:
You are given n coins.

You want to arrange them in a staircase shape such that:

Row 1 has 1 coin
Row 2 has 2 coins
Row 3 has 3 coins
and so on...

Each row must be completely filled before starting the next.

Return the number of complete rows you can build.
input_format: The input contains a single integer.
